reason: This is a purely additive new module (OrchardCore.DataLocalization) plus new abstractions/services that are opt-in and not wired into any existing feature, with the only touch to shared code being an additional project reference and a new AddDataLocalization extension method, so existing tenants/modules are extremely unlikely to be affected unless they explicitly enable the new feature.
